name: start-here
description: START HERE. Entry-point for building a form with ReFormer using ONLY this MCP server. Returns the canonical workflow of the unified form contract (model → one schema → one assembly `createForm` → validation → the one behavior → wizard → draw), a map of which prompt/tool/resource to use at each step, and the reading order. Call this first when asked to build or modify a ReFormer form.

name: discover-context
description: Собирает контекст проекта (target stack, UI-компоненты, стили, валидация, async-паттерны) одним batched sampling-запросом к клиенту. Возвращает JSON-рекомендацию для последующих prompts (create-form / add-* / plan-form). Если клиент не поддерживает sampling — возвращает шаблон вопросов для ручного ответа пользователя.

arguments.name: projectPath
arguments.description: Путь к каталогу проекта для auto-detection стека.

name: review
description: Cross-package review of ReFormer code. Slim+ prompt that points the model at MCP resources for full anti-pattern lists; only critical inline rules stay in the message body.

arguments.name: code
arguments.description: The code to review (paste the relevant snippet).

name: plan-form
description: Build a @reformer form from a markdown spec: a summary of the spec (steps, conditional and computed fields, arrays, API), then plan_form drafts form.intent.json and form_build builds it.

arguments.name: specPath
arguments.description: Markdown spec of the form, absolute or relative to the working directory. E.g. docs/specs/credit-application-form.md

arguments.name: projectPath
arguments.description: Project folder whose package.json is used to detect the stack (as in create-form). Default: the server working directory.

name: create-form
description: Create a new @reformer form from a description: get the intent grammar, write form.intent.json, build it with form_build. Includes the detected project stack.

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: The form in your own words: fields, types, initial values, links. E.g. "Sign-up: email, password, confirmPassword (must match), age (number, 18+)".

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Stack: "core" (you write the JSX markup), "renderer-react" (FormRenderer draws a TS schema), "renderer-json" (the schema is a JSON document + registry). Default "core".

arguments.name: projectPath
arguments.description: Project folder whose package.json is used to detect the stack (UI kit, Tailwind). Default: the server working directory.

name: add-feature
description: Add one capability to a form built with form_build — validation rules, behavior, an array of rows or wizard steps — by editing form.intent.json and building again. Pick the stage with `feature`.

arguments.name: requirements
arguments.description: What to add. For `feature: wizard` — the steps and the fields of each.

arguments.name: code
arguments.description: The current form.intent.json (optional: otherwise read it from the form folder).

name: to-renderer
description: Switch a form built with form_build to a renderer — FormRenderer over the TS schema (renderer-react) or the schema as a JSON document + registry (renderer-json) — by changing "target" in form.intent.json and building again.

arguments.name: code
arguments.description: The current form.intent.json (optional: otherwise read it from the form folder).
